text:
Maya: Who else is seeing this weird golden-hour fog on the 9? Bus crawling through the hills, took 25 mins longer than usual :fog: :bus:
Sam: yup! looked like a low cloud soup. took an Uber from 3rd. worth the splurge tbh
Jordan: Golden-hour fog + commuter chaos = cinematic commute. someone start a podcast
Leah: Photo incoming in a sec — tilt-shifted city looks like a toy set
Priya: stuck at oak & 5, driver just said 'reduced visibility' and pacing at 20mph. anyone splitting to scooters?
Maya: tempted but my scooter battery is at 16% :grimacing: might just wait
Sam: Quick poll: :thumbsup: stay on the bus, :scooter: bail and scoot? react to vote
Jordan: :scooter: (would if it wasn't pouring earlier)
Leah: :thumbsup: waiting for the next express — need to get on a call
TransportBot: Caltrain update: 07:18 northbound delayed 12 mins due to signal issue near Millbrae. https://caltrain.status.example/alerts
Priya: Hmm. carpool? @Sam @Maya anyone heading past 7th? I can swing by
Maya: I'm heading into the city, can pick up if I leave in 10. ping if you want a ride
Sam: I'm already in an Uber, thanks! enjoy the fog views
Jordan: If someone snaps a pic that looks like a movie poster, I will make a dramatic caption. no pressure :camera_flash:
Leah: posted pic: https://imgur.example/foggy9bus — it's peak toy-city
Maya: That photo is stunning. need it as a wallpaper
Priya: ETA update: starting to move, looks like traffic easing
Jordan: commute victory or defeat? victory — made it without soggy shoes :sweat_smile:
